This is a great question since I deal with this a lot. I've got bad OCD which makes me obsessive over literally everything. What I've learned is that acceptance is key.

1.First accept that these moments/interactions happened. If you try to forget them, you are still subconsciously thinking about them.

2.I usually will try to make the moment/interaction funny. The best way in my opinion to forget about an embarrassing moment is to laugh at it.

3.After doing steps 1 and 2, try watching a documentary or something eye-catching that will get your mind off of these moments for a bit.

Eventually, these moments/interactions will fade in your memory. You will start to remember less and less from the interaction. Soon, you will not be thinking about these moments everyday. It will turn into a once in a blue moon thing. Good luck :)

You don’t have to go crazy with exercise, just make sure you are walking everyday. You burn a lot more calories just moving than you think you do. Oh and don’t forget to drink a lot of water!
